briefHtml:
NAV S$10,358,397 · watcher −0.53% (indicative; navHistory +0.07%) · listed flag −2.81% (stale)

  • Biggest mover: the Fed itself. Unanimous 12–0, +25bp to 3.75–4.00% — first hike since Jul 2023, first under Warsh; dots pencil one more hike in 2026. Dow −1.2% (~630pts), S&P −0.45% to 7,551.81, Nasdaq ~flat; 10y topped 5%; dollar up, gold down.
  • The one thing: "one-and-done" is dead, but the reaction was orderly. Warsh: "predominant focus is on the price stability side." Trump overnight: rates "should be 1% or less… LOWER THE INTEREST RATES… AND FAST!" Today's Asia session (9am SGT) is the first post-FOMC trading for HK/SGX.

Risk flags — 3 critical, all stale-baseline artifacts (5th day)

  • GDX flag −6.7% vs verified $92.80, −1.41% Wed close
  • SILJ flag −10.4% vs verified $28.62, −1.92%
  • SLVP flag −10.3% vs verified $36.58, −1.75% (all stockanalysis.com 4pm EDT closes)
  • L46.SI Yahoo feed 404, 5th session

Position moves (verified Wed closes)

  • US ETFs: SILJ $28.62 (−1.92%) · SLVP $36.58 (−1.75%) · GDX $92.80 (−1.41%)
  • HK (pre-FOMC): SMIC HK$63.65 +4.77% · Tencent HK$433.40 −1.23% · Xiaomi HK$26.18 −1.21% · HSI +0.19% 24,713.78
  • SGX (pre-FOMC): STI −0.06% 5,635.41 · DBS S$76.80 +0.07%

Insider trades (7 days)

  • Wing Tai (W05.SI): Form 1 "Change in Interest of Director" filings for Chairman & MD Cheng Wai Keung broadcast Sep 10, 11, 14, 15, 16 — near-daily cadence since July. SGX filing (Sep 14) · Wing Tai IR
  • None found for other held SGX/HK names. US holdings are ETFs — no insider reports exist.

Congress trades (filed Sep 14–16)

  • FL-19 Rep: sells HWM, PH ($1K–$15K each); buys NFLX — filed Sep 16
  • NJ-5 Dem: MSFT options two-sided $250K–$1M; QSR/AMAT/RSG buys — filed Sep 15
  • WA-1 Dem: NYC TFA muni $15K–$50K; TX-11 Rep: CHTR/LBRDK exchange — filed Sep 15
  • Sen. King (I-ME): EA sell $15K–$50K; Rep. Kean (R-NJ-7): MSFT/GOOGL/AMCR/JNJ sells, LIN/MTZ buys — filed Sep 14
  • Source: Unusual Whales

Trump / policy watch

  • FOMC unanimous hawkish hike; dots one more 2026 hike; Warsh: "inflation is the problem", "committed to a discipline, not a decision". Yahoo live
  • Trump: Warsh "has a tough board", rates "too high"; overnight post — rates "should be 1% or less… AND FAST!" Newsquawk
  • Bessent: US open to discussing shared risks with China in AI talks this weekend (Axios) — HK AI tail-risk reducer. Newsquawk
  • Defense: US intel warns China could acquire F-35 tech via Saudi sale (NYT). Newsquawk
  • Oil fades despite war: WTI $102.43 (−3.40), Brent $105.83 (−2.92); US output to records. Newsquawk
  • Next: BoE today; US claims + housing starts tonight; BOJ expected to hike to 31-yr high Friday. Schwab

Alpha — signals, not advice

  • Defense/duration (15% vs ~0%): trigger CONFIRMED — 10y ≥5% post-statement, dots added a hike, Warsh names capex+geopolitics as yield drivers. Start tranche build per plan.
  • Silver/SLVP/SILJ (20% vs ~4%): silver ~$63 held through the hike; miners fell only 1.4–1.9%. $62–64 holds through Friday's BOJ = reload zone; <$60 = wait.
  • HK AI (Asia 10% vs ~3%; AI 15% vs ~1%): SMIC +4.77% pre-FOMC on memory-tightness tape; Tencent front-ran one-and-done — expect pressure at today's open. Stagger tranches only on stabilization.

trumpWatch.title: FOMC: unanimous +25bp to 3.75-4.00%, dots pencil one more 2026 hike
trumpWatch.detail: 12-0 vote, first hike since Jul 2023, first under Chair Warsh. Statement: 'timelier return to 2 percent goal'. Warsh: 'predominant focus is on the price stability side'; 'inflation is too high and has been for too long'; yields up on econ strength, capex surge, geopolitics; futures split on October.

trumpWatch.title: Trump: rates 'should be 1% or less… AND FAST!'
trumpWatch.detail: Overnight post after the hike; earlier said Warsh 'has a tough board', still has confidence in him, but rates are 'too high and not appropriate'. Open Fed-White House conflict now runs alongside a live hiking cycle.

trumpWatch.title: Bessent: US open to shared-risk discussion with China in AI talks this weekend
trumpWatch.detail: Axios report via Newsquawk. De-escalation channel for the HK AI barbell. Same feed: US-Mexico trade talks pushed back one week (WSJ); US names Mexico and China major drug-transit countries.

trumpWatch.title: F-35 to Saudi: US intel warns China could acquire jet technology
trumpWatch.detail: NYT report — spying or Saudi cooperation could leak advanced airpower tech to China; complicates the Gulf sale, keeps the defense budget cycle bid.

trumpWatch.title: Oil settles lower despite Saudi pipeline shut: WTI $102.43, Brent $105.83
trumpWatch.detail: WTI -$3.40, Brent -$2.92 Wednesday; fresh strikes but crude faded; Melius sees US oil/gas output hitting records. One less inflation impulse for the Fed.

trumpWatch.title: BoE today, BOJ tomorrow: central-bank pile-up continues
trumpWatch.detail: BoE and CNB decide Sep 17; US jobless claims + housing starts tonight; BOJ expected to hike to a 31-year high Sep 18. BoC minutes: near-term inflation to stay elevated.
